prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: neck and back strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1148; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was operating a vehicle in the ordinary course of travel when your insured's vehicle crossed into the opposing lane and struck our client's car head-on. Although the impact occurred at a low rate of speed, the force was sufficient to cause immediate pain and restricted movement. Our client was transported for evaluation and later diagnosed with cervical and lumbar strain, accompanied by muscle spasm, headaches, and reduced range of motion. Treatment has included physical therapy and prescribed medication, and our client continues to experience limitations in daily activities, sleep, and work duties.

The police report documents the lane departure by your insured and records that our client was not at fault. Liability under the circumstances is clear, and we see no reasonable basis for disputing it.

Based on the medical records, treatment charges, lost wages, and the impact on our client's quality of life, we are prepared to resolve this claim for the sum of [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice to your company.
